name: basedpyright
description: VS Code static type checking for Python (but based)
readme:
# BasedPyright

Python language support powered by the bundled basedpyright language server (a pyright fork): type-checking diagnostics, completion, hover, go to definition, find all references, and signature help.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.
